versions.changelog:
golang-samber-lo 1.2.0

- Added recommendations and integration notes for using companion skills (`golang-pkg-go-dev`/`godig` and `golang-gopls`/`gopls`) to better navigate documentation and code usage.
- Expanded compatibility note to include Codex and similar platforms.
- Added a `paths` directive to explicitly scope the skill to Go source files.
- Updated metadata version to 1.2.0.
- Removed legacy `skill-card.md` file.

- Made the skill user-invocable (user-invocable: true).
- Updated best practices and mistakes sections for latest Go stdlib: clarified use of slices.Collect(maps.Keys(m)) for Go 1.23+ and improved guidance on stdlib vs. lo usage.
- Added or updated metadata: set version to 1.1.0 and included skill-library-version.
- Improved skill description by adding cross-link formatting.
- Minor text edits throughout for accuracy and Go version specificity.

- Version incremented to 1.0.3 and metadata updated accordingly.
- Compatibility note: Added AskUserQuestion to allowed tools.
- Minor text fix: "more informations" corrected to "more information" in documentation.
- No functional or feature changes; documentation only.

golang-samber-lo version 1.0.1

- Added an evaluation manifest file (`evals/evals.json`).
- Updated SKILL.md metadata: set version to 1.0.1 (was 1.0.0) and adjusted formatting of the description. 
- No breaking changes to usage or API.

Initial release of golang-samber-lo skill.

- Provides structured knowledge and best practices for using the samber/lo functional utilities library in Go, including Map, Filter, Reduce, GroupBy, Chunk, Flatten, and more.
- Explains package variants (lo, parallel/lop, mutable/lom, iterator/loi, experimental SIMD) and guides choosing the right one based on trade-offs and performance.
- Details common mistakes and best practices for efficient, idiomatic usage alongside the Go standard library.
- Includes quick reference examples and installation guidance.
- Not intended for streaming pipelines—refer to golang-samber-ro for such use cases.
